about: ABB India Limited develops and sells products and system solutions to utilities, industries, channel partners, and original equipment manufacturers in India and internationally. It operates through Motion, Robotics and Discrete Automation, Electrification, and Process Automation segments. The Motion segment offers motors, generators, and drives that provide power, motion, and control for a range of automation applications; as well as solutions and related services.
